title: Create a quote
summary: New quote: patient, date, currency, branch and the items with quantity and price. It stays as a draft.

steps.title: Menu → Sales → Quotes
steps.details: The treatment plan with prices for the patient to approve; once confirmed it's invoiced, booked and charged.

steps.title: Patient
steps.details: Choose the patient. If they don't show up, register them first.

steps.title: Currency
steps.details: If you choose a currency other than the clinic's, the exchange rate shows up.

steps.title: Items
steps.details: Each line is a service or product with quantity, price and total.

steps.title: Service
steps.details: The price is filled in from the list; you can change it.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: It stays as a draft: you can review, send and confirm it later.
